issues.description: ADM-UI-09 is marked MUST in tests/specs/ADM-UI-09.md but has no implemented integration test file; traceability maps only to web/tests/e2e/f5-admin-observability.e2e.spec.ts.

tests/integration/obs03_audit_log_test.zig uses error.SkipZigTest when BPM_TEST_DB_URL is missing; this violates the hard gate requiring clear failure rather than skip for integration tests covering MUST requirements.
tests/integration/obs03_audit_log_test.zig uses static fixture UUID literals in multiple tests instead of per-test UUID-generated fixtures, violating fixture-isolation requirements.
web/tests/e2e/f5-admin-observability.e2e.spec.ts contains hardcoded credential defaults (admin-user/admin-pass), violating the no-hardcoded-credentials security check.
